name: poker-prive
description: Plateforme de poker privée entre amis (Texas Hold'em No-Limit, jetons virtuels uniquement)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker/engine && npm run build -w @poker/server && npm run build -w @poker/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @poker/engine && npm run test -w @poker/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @poker/engine && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @poker/server" "npm run dev -w @poker/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web "npm run start -w @poker/server" "npm run start -w @poker/web"
